title: cestrum terminale
intro: Cestrum terminale, commonly known as the night-blooming jessamine or queen of the night, is a plant species native to Central and South America, known for its unique ability to bloom only at night. The health benefits of Cestrum terminale include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality, making it a popular natural remedy for insomnia and other sleep disorders. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, that exhibit sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Cestrum terminale also show promise in reducing oxidative stress and improving cardiovascular health.
